question:
What will the value of the following expression be?

((6+3)/(3)) – 5 × (4 + 5)
solution:
**Given:**

((6+3)/(3)) – 5 × (4 + 5)

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

Preference for arithmetic operations will be given on the basis of letters coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculation:**

((6+3))/(3) - 5 × (4 + 5)

= 3 - 5 × (9)

= 3 - 45

= - 42

**Hence, The Required simplified value is - 42.**
